line.name: San Lotano Dominicano
line.description: Genuine, separate San Lotano sub-line made at Tabacalera Palma (Jose 'Jochy' Blanco's Dominican factory), distributed by Abdel Fernandez. Explicitly Dominican-made, contrasting with the Nicaraguan-made San Lotano Requiem line. Not currently listed on the site at all (site has Requiem, Requiem Connecticut, Requiem Maduro, The Bull, Oval, but not Dominicano).

research_notes: Confirmed by halfwheel and multiple retailer listings (CigarsDirect, Neptune Cigar, Holt's, Gotham, Smoke Inn).
